profile_text.body:
Course Hero describes itself as a study platform offering instant access to millions of study resources, course notes, test prep, 24/7 homework help, and tutors. The company says it is a Learneo, Inc. business, and its site carries a notice that Course Hero is not sponsored or endorsed by any college or university. It was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Redwood City.

Among the products tracked for the company is QuillBot, listed under writing and editing with a note of paraphrasing. The site text harvested also includes student-posted coursework, such as a question about identifying a sample and population from a reading on single Americans in their 20s and a Rutgers University National Marriage Project survey.

No litigation, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded for Course Hero.
